rationale: DFT scan is per-implementation, not protocol-level

extraction_strategy.ic_class_applicability_gate_v0_1_62: ic_class='serial_peripheral_protocol' declares LL20 not applicable; emitted as N/A stub (l_doc_taxonomy.na_stub)

fields.notes: IO-Link's protocol-level DFT surface is the per-character even parity, the per-M-sequence CKT/CKS checksum, the Device status octet and Events, and the Direct Parameter page / ISDU readback. Chip-level JTAG / scan / BIST remain Device-vendor / SoC-integrator concerns; conformance is established by IO-Link (IEC 61131-9, SDCI) compliance testing.
internal_diagnostics: Loopback (MCR.LOOP=1) — SOUT internally drives SIN; modem outputs drive modem inputs.
Error simulation through loopback — break, parity, overrun, framing error scenarios reproducible without external hardware.
FIFO reset (FCR.RX_FIFO_RESET / FCR.TX_FIFO_RESET) — self-clearing in-chip RAM reset.
